crossRefs.note: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near…
Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son…
The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.
translations.bsb: Gilead remained beyond the Jordan. Dan, why did you linger by the ships? Asher stayed at the coast and remained in his harbors.
translations.kjv: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
translations.asv: Gilead abode beyond the Jordan: And Dan, why did he remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, And abode by his creeks.
